title: Chapter 412
paragraphs: Chapter 412
Episode 120. Why Hyran? (6)
Cough-!

The place where the claw stabbed was the neck. Although the Spirit Armor perfectly protects the neck as it has no seams, it was impossible to block the blow of a Black Knight-level monster without any impact.
Blood overflowed into the helmet formed by Multa's rune. The chilling pain that spread throughout the body was so intense that it felt like the neck had been torn for a moment.
Thud! Thump!
The claw struck Jin's neck again. Amid the excruciating pain that made his hair stand on end, Jin swung Sigmund.
"You talk about the next master, but you put your life on the line too easily. What's the big deal about friendship? If it weren't for the armor, you'd be dead."
I pushed in because I had armor, and you stabbed me because you knew that fact.
Jin wanted to answer like that, but his voice couldn't come out for now. Only the sound of boiling blood from his throat.
'I got hit once, it's so damn painful...!'
The premise that Danté would not be killed but abducted.
He had forgotten about it due to the monster's sudden behavior. Even if Jin had stayed still, the monster's claw would have stopped before piercing Danté's neck.
However, Jin wasn't just being victimized either.
Behind the monster, which was relentlessly attacking with its claw, a pitch-black sphere of spiritual energy suddenly emerged. The sphere originated from the Bradamante stuck in the ground.
And the monster didn't notice the energy. It was because spiritual energy is an imperceptible force, unlike aura or magic.
Fizzle!
With Sigmund brilliantly spewing lightning, the monster had no chance to pay attention to its rear.
However, when the claw and blade collided, the lightning shook the body, and Jin secretly stuck out his tongue at the fact that the monster didn't flinch.
"Phew, I can finally speak. You keep saying I'm risking my life for Danté... What about you?"
Don't you have to risk it too?
Jin spat out the rest of the words and unfolded the Sword King's technique, the Waterfall.
Countless lightning fragments pouring from the sword blurred the monster's vision.
The claw left a trail while fending off the lightning, and Jin deliberately slowed down the tempo while pretending to adjust his breath.
Ask.
With the heart of a fisherman who had thrown a fishing rod, Jin was looking forward to the monster recklessly approaching to finish him off.
The monster still didn't know what was happening behind it.
'You fell for it.'
The monster narrowed the distance to Jin while blocking some of the lightning from the waterfall. The spine-chilling gleam behind the mask was ominous.
With all his strength, Jin swung Sigmund. A blow filled with monstrous strength, even the monster couldn't handle it with one hand.
Instead, the monster overlapped its claws to block Sigmund, twisted the blade downward, and intended to stab Jin's neck again.
No matter how amazing the armor was, if it continued to take hits in the same area, it would eventually be the end.
'You're too confident. If it's a full-strength blow, did you think I'd back off a little?'
However, it was then that the sphere of spiritual energy formed behind the monster began to move.
The sudden reaction of the mysterious attacker could only be explained by the unique intuition gained through experiencing numerous life-and-death battles.
'What's going on...?'

It felt as dangerous as having a blade against his neck. Although the strike on the 12th class member was blocked, and it should have been a valid hit, for some reason, Jin's face, hidden behind the helmet, seemed to be smiling.
The mysterious attacker withdrew his claw.
At that moment, all the mysterious attacker could gain was a brief moment, just enough time for a blink of an eye.
He had given up on a potentially incapacitating strike just to buy that short amount of time.
'Impressive, worthy of a Black Knight.'
Jin genuinely admired the scene. He knew very well that deciding to give up on a valid strike and preparing for defense in this situation was not an easy decision.
'Well, it would have been a problem if this guy died.'
If he hadn't bought that brief moment, the mysterious attacker would have lost his life. Jin was sure of it.
Something grazed the mysterious attacker's back.
It was a dark blade of energy released from the sphere of spirit energy. It was the energy that Jin had stored just before throwing the Bradamante.

Like when forming a curtain or harmony, the spirit energy moved according to Jin's will. It was an attack that could never be accomplished with aura, and it was possible because spirit energy belonged to the realm of 'authority' rather than just 'power.'
The one who lost their stance due to the blade released from the sphere of spirit energy was, ironically, the mysterious attacker.
Jin didn't miss that moment. Sigmund was charging towards the mysterious attacker, full of lightning energy.
The mysterious attacker decided that even if a single dark blade cut his back, blocking Sigmund would be the priority.
But that wasn't the real attack.
'I can't end this hard-earned opportunity with just one strike.'
Roar-!
Suddenly, a mass of light-element magic burst from Jin's palm.
Flash Cannon, an ancient legacy of the Great Wizard Chenmi. It was a magic that was almost useless for the highest-level warriors, but in a situation like this, it was a different story.

No matter how great a Black Knight may be, when a sudden flash of light is shot into their pupils, there's nothing they can do. Unless there's a huge skill gap where they can fight with their eyes closed.
Blood splattered.
Sigmund slashed the mysterious attacker's chest. This time, the wound was by no means shallow. A heavy sensation of flesh and bone catching on the blade was transmitted.

The mysterious attacker hastily created a barrier with his claw, but it didn't end there. Even if he was a highly trained warrior pushed to the limit, his eyes wouldn't recover easily from the exposure to the Flash Cannon.
Until the mysterious attacker's eyes recovered, Jin would have complete control.
"How is it? It must be your first time fighting a magic swordsman, right?"
Thud!

This time, he pierced through the barrier and stabbed the mysterious attacker's thigh. Although the mysterious attacker showed an immediate reaction to each attack, it seemed unlikely that he would regain control even if his vision returned.
The 5 seconds that felt like hell for the mysterious man and like a sweet oasis in the desert for Jin passed by. Gradually, the mysterious man's vision began to return.
Hoo, huk...
Contrary to the previous leisurely demeanor, the mysterious man's rough breathing showed he was adjusting his posture.

Jin, with a smile, locked eyes with him and said, "It seems you didn't understand what I said earlier, so I'll say it again. Retreat, your mission is a failure. Tell your master that I will handle Hiran my way."
Jin had heard rumors about the greatness of the 12th generation.

He had not seen the single-handed overturning of the Sword Garden recently, but even those who tried to ostracize the 12th generation praised their incredible power. Jin wanted to cross swords and see what kind of person he was.
At first, Jin was disappointed.
The thought of throwing away an opportunity to bring down Hiran for something like friendship seemed far-fetched, and the rumors of a great fighter appeared to be false.

Next, he felt as if the mysterious man was using a messy sword technique. Jin wondered if he still didn't know that he could never reach the pinnacle of swordsmanship with tricks and underhanded abilities.
But now, Jin found himself succumbing to those tricks and losing the advantage.
Despite objectively having superior power, Jin was struggling.
'No... Not just me, but the 12th generation also hasn't fully unleashed their power. If we both fight with our lives on the line, I can't guarantee the outcome.'
It was strange.
Facing Jin, he had such thoughts. Despite not resembling Run Kandel in any way as he kept talking about friendship... Why did his gaze seem to contain the dignity of an emperor?
The man appeared to be a swindler who relied on tricks, but his eyes held a depth that couldn't be easily judged.
It was a unique atmosphere he hadn't felt from other generations.
He was torn.
Whether to secure Dante even if it meant pushing harder or to back down now. Which decision was the right one?
And Jin seemed to see right through his dilemma.
"You can't do that, Black Knight."
The mysterious man's eyes grew wider beneath the mask.

"You are a black helmet for the family, not a generation. What you need is not a fight but efficient mission completion. Risking your life for a mission that has already failed is a huge loss for the family. Go back and prepare for the next one."
Thud, rumble, rumble...!
Shockwaves from the battle outside continued to be transmitted to the castle.
Cracks appeared on the inner walls of the great hall, as if they were about to collapse any moment, and dust from the ceiling rained down.
The pillars supporting the structure shook precariously, as if they would break with a single tap.
"It seems like the perfect situation to make an exit," Jin remarked.
At that moment, one of the pillars broke, and the floor began to sink. The great hall's destruction meant that the Sword Emperor's castle was crumbling as a whole.
In the end, the mysterious man turned away.

And he draped the corpses of the other fallen mysterious men over his shoulder. Before leaving, he said without looking back, "I'll pretend I didn't see your bluff. If your decision today threatens Run Kandel, the Black Helmets will come to claim your life personally."
Before Jin could reply, the mysterious man left the great hall through the broken wall.
Once the man was out of sight, Jin knelt on one knee and exhaled heavily.
'Even with the Spirit Armor's protection, I'm seriously injured...'
If the mysterious man had continued to fight, Jin would have suffered significant damage as well.

He had the last resort of Black Flash, so he wouldn't have lost his life, but it was uncertain if he could have protected Dante. It's unknown what choices the mysterious man would have made if cornered.
From Run Kandel's perspective, Dante's death wouldn't have been a completely terrible outcome.
The fatigue from the consecutive rough battles was hitting him all at once.
'After sending Dante off, I should check the outside.'
Crash-!
The ceiling began to collapse entirely. Jin quickly grabbed Dante and escaped the great hall, heading towards the outer castle.
The outer walls near the great hall had also crumbled. Climbing up to the remaining intact outer walls, Jin saw the battlefield where Ron and Velact were fighting.
Nothing was left near the battlefield. The central arena had disappeared without a trace, and the surrounding buildings were all destroyed, leaving only signs of destruction.
"Ugh, ugh..."
Dante, regaining consciousness, let out a heavy groan.
Are you awake, Dante?
But Jin couldn't ask that.
Drenched in blood and gasping for breath, Ron Hiran's shocking appearance left Jin momentarily speechless. In front of him was the similarly wounded Velact.
